mostWorthwhile.text: Lighting the finished kaleidoscope made the mirror and colour-drum construction pay off in a vivid changing pattern.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive tube and eyepiece fittings were straightforward but a little repetitive.

surprise.text: Leaving space in the drum matters: the shapes must slide to make the pattern change.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several fittings were simply the only offered next step.

continue.text: I would continue: the explanations of repeated reflections and sliding shapes made the construction worth the time, and the finished pattern was appealing.
